dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 with structured programming constructs; ASSIGN TO PRINTER clause suggests possible Micro Focus or similar PC/workstation COBOL environment

purpose.domain_detail: Academic lab exercise (Lab 7) for a COBOL programming course covering multi-level control breaks and arrays
purpose.summary: This program reads a student file containing department code, class code, student name, and four test scores. It performs a two-level control break (major break on department, minor break on class), calculates test averages, assigns letter grades, and prints a grouped summary report. It is a student lab assignment with placeholder comments indicating where code must be inserted.

notable_features: Multi-level control break using EVALUATE TRUE
OCCURS 4 TIMES array for test scores (SR-GRADE-ARRAY, DL-GRADE-ARRAY)
PERFORM VARYING with subscript for array processing
Nested IF for letter grade assignment (A/B/C/D/F)
ASSIGN TO PRINTER clause for report output
ACCEPT FROM DATE for current date
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: The AUTHOR field is 'YOUR NAME' confirming this is a student template/lab skeleton. Comments explicitly instruct the student to insert code. The ASSIGN TO PRINTER syntax is characteristic of older PC COBOL compilers (e.g., Micro Focus Personal COBOL or similar). No lines exceed 72 characters, confirming fixed format.
